name: NOVO Protocol
fix_description: Uncomment the _approve check in transferFrom that verifies msg.sender has sufficient allowance from the sender. The allowance deduction was commented out, allowing anyone to transfer tokens from any address without approval.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, direct exploit built around an obvious token bug: transferFrom allows arbitrary from addresses, letting the attacker drain tokens from the LP, call sync, and dump at a manipulated price. Although it uses a flashswap and AMM price manipulation, the attack flow is only a few straightforward steps and the PoC is compact with minimal protocol-specific complexity.
